name: trial-state.txt
command: date -u; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id /proc/uptime /opt/boot-inventory/helper.log /opt/minimal-saver/last-boot.log; systemctl show AT-HUB.service app-boot-manager.service display-manager.service sdbd.service -p Id -p Type -p ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic -p ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic -p Result; vconftool get memory/appfw/current_fullscreen_appid; ps -eo pid,comm | grep -E 'Boot|Recorder|MiniHub|DN_spotlight'; true

name: resume-paths.txt
command: ls -l /usr/bin/*resume* /usr/bin/*splash* 2>/dev/null; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do test -r "$p/comm" || continue; read c < "$p/comm"; case "$c" in app_resume) readlink "$p/exe"; tr '\000' ' ' < "$p/cmdline"; echo;; esac; done; true
